newsitem.title: EGYPT: Average Egypt pound overnight rate falls.
newsitem.headline: Average Egypt pound overnight rate falls.

text.p: Average overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell on Tuesday in a liquid private-sector market. Bankers quoted a range of 9-7/8 to 10-1/8 percent, against Monday's range of 10 to 10-1/8 percent.
"There are a lot of rejected T-bill bids," one banker explained. The central bank received bids for bills worth 1,676.650 million pounds but accepted only 751.450 million.
The bankers quoted one-week rates at around 10-1/16 against between 10 and 10-3/16 percent on Monday.
Public-sector banks kept rates steady at 10-1/2 percent.
